processing.policy: Ground colour only. Union each explicit class separately, preserve polygon holes and clip to existing municipal boundary and source bbox. Different source classes can genuinely overlap and remain separate: suggested paint order is listed from low to high; actual water surfaces remain above ground colours. Non-area labels, nature_reserve/protected_area/historic designations, rock/sand and all unclassified land are omitted, never inferred as park/forest. Existing urban colour may be a lower-priority base, not a replacement for mapped natural classes. Park describes mapped use, not measured grass coverage. Simplification changes only display boundaries within the recorded tolerance. No runtime mesh, terrain, buildings or urban-building-clusters is modified.
